title: 基于LoRA增强对比学习的SAS视觉Transformer目标识别
summary: 该研究将DINOv3视觉Transformer适配于合成孔径声呐自动目标识别，采用三阶段参数高效框架：LoRA微调、难负样本挖掘和监督对比学习。实验表明LoRA是主要增益来源，AUPRC从0.300提升至0.679，仅训练0.26%权重；后续精炼阶段无显著提升。
summary_en: This work adapts DINOv3 Vision Transformers to synthetic aperture sonar automatic target recognition using a three-stage parameter-efficient framework: LoRA fine-tuning, hard-negative mining, and supervised contrastive learning. Results show LoRA drives the primary gain, raising AUPRC from 0.300 to 0.679 while training only 0.26% of weights; subsequent refinement stages yield no significant improvement.
